findings.title: Immediate registration is not atomic adoption; workload executes before recoverable authorization
findings.counterexample: After the background child is launched but before own_register runs, a pending TERM can invoke the exiting trap with OWN_PIDS still empty; this remains possible between the separate pid=$! and own_register commands even though the old sleep was removed. [T0, lines 91-92 and 110-113](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/ctl-t0-only.v8.sh#L110-L113) [Setup, lines 95-98 and 129-131](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v8.sh#L129-L131)
findings.workload_admission: Both consumers exec the real Jest/npm command directly in the spawned child before parent confirmation or recoverable identity publication; there is no child-side release gate, and a failed confirmation only attempts to stop work that may already have run. [T0, lines 110-115](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/ctl-t0-only.v8.sh#L110-L115) [Setup, lines 129-134](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v8.sh#L129-L134)
findings.consequence: An interrupt can still leave an unregistered detached workload, and install mutation/network activity is not conditioned on safe recoverable adoption as required by the contract. [Scope, line 16](../../OWNED_LAUNCH_SCOPE.md#L16) [Setup, lines 129-132](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v8.sh#L129-L132)
findings.minimal_closure: Preserve pending interruptions throughout launch/adoption, make the child recoverably identifiable before workload release, and gate workload execution on successful verified adoption/publication; no increased sleep can establish this.
findings.coverage_gap: C1v8 sends its deterministic TERM only after registration and child.pid publication, so passing it would not discriminate the remaining pre-registration gap. [Fixture, lines 33-34](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/sup-under-test.sh#L33-L34)

findings.title: Topology rechecking does not distinguish current ownership from reused numeric identities
findings.counterexample: A registered child exits and is reaped, its PID is reused by an unrelated process, and later own_reap_all calls own_signal on the retained number: a nonleader replacement receives pid-only TERM, while an unrelated session-leader replacement satisfying pid==pgid==sid receives group TERM. [Primitive, lines 5-17 and 20-25](../../s5-v8-t0/own-block-v8.sh#L5-L25)
findings.consumer_bypasses: The controls retain every numeric fixture PID until final cleanup, and setup's retained reap_group authorizes TERM/KILL by membership in the historical OWNED_PGIDS string rather than the new helper's current identity test. [Controls, lines 16-26 and 39-48](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/ctl-own-startup.sh#L16-L48) [Setup, lines 74-80 and 141](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v8.sh#L74-L80)
findings.consequence: Caller-group exclusion alone does not satisfy no-unowned-signals: a different process can be signalled after PID/group-number reuse, including by the synthetic control cleanup itself. [Scope, line 16](../../OWNED_LAUNCH_SCOPE.md#L16) [Primitive, lines 15-17](../../s5-v8-t0/own-block-v8.sh#L15-L17)
findings.minimal_closure: Bind active ownership to a recoverable process identity beyond bare PID/topology, retire signal authority after confirmed absence, and apply the same current-identity guard to every consumer and control cleanup route; mismatched identity must refuse rather than fall back to signalling a replacement PID.

findings.title: Leader exit disables descendant cleanup, and setup can release the lease with survivors
findings.counterexample: A confirmed leader exits on TERM while its same-group grandchild ignores TERM: own_wait_gone sees the leader gone, skips KILL escalation, and the final group census only prints GROUP_SURVIVORS without terminating the remaining owned child. [Primitive, lines 20-25](../../s5-v8-t0/own-block-v8.sh#L20-L25)
findings.after_leader_exit: For a leader already reaped, own_signal returns gone without signalling the still-populated group, so T0's post-exit calls to own_signal cannot perform the cleanup they replaced; its EXIT reaper likewise skips the dead leader and only reports the group. [Primitive, lines 15-25](../../s5-v8-t0/own-block-v8.sh#L15-L25) [T0, lines 91 and 118-122](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/ctl-t0-only.v8.sh#L118-L122)
findings.setup_consequence: On setup interruption, own_reap_all replaces the previous group reap, then finish 143 exits even if final accounting finds descendants; because the install child closed fd9, this can release the canonical lease while owned install work remains, with no checked recovery holder or quarantine transition. [Setup, lines 87-98 and 129](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v8.sh#L87-L98)
findings.minimal_closure: Retain safe descendant/group authority independently of leader liveness, escalate according to the whole owned boundary, and verify it empty before handoff; if termination cannot be verified, retain explicit exclusion/recovery ownership rather than merely log survivors and exit.

findings.title: Identity-refusal paths still perform unconditional waits after unconfirmed termination
findings.counterexample: If own_confirm fails and the child is still alive after TERM/KILL and the bounded polls, T0 sets m=pid:<pid> but keeps how=identity-refused, so line 118 takes wait; setup explicitly waits after incrementing CLEANUP_FAILURES for the same failed termination, and the fixture does likewise. findings.title: The proposed control driver is not cancellation-safe and its scenarios omit required contract discriminators
findings.driver_counterexample: If the outer caller interrupts ctl-own-startup while run_sup is waiting, the current child's identity has not joined FIXTURE_PIDS because that happens only after the synchronous timeout returns; the driver has only an EXIT trap, and no active-supervisor cancellation/adoption route, so its cleanup cannot account for that newly detached child. [Controls, lines 16-26](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/ctl-own-startup.sh#L16-L26)
findings.cleanup_counterexample: cleanup_fixtures sends signals to retained bare PIDs and never verifies post-KILL absence or turns cleanup failure into a failing exit, so its own final SUMMARY can be emitted without proving fixture quiescence. [Controls, lines 19-20](../../s5-v8-t0/controls-v8-t0/ctl-own-startup.sh#L19-L20)
discriminator_gaps: C1v8 does not target pre-registration interruption, while no case injects failed identity/receipt publication or a reused identity; these are specifically required boundaries rather than optional coverage expansion. findings.minimal_closure: Own the active control enclosure and recoverable child identity before waiting, handle cancellation through verified bounded cleanup, retire resolved identities, and exercise acknowledged pre/post-adoption seams, publication failure, reuse refusal, natural exit, leader-first exit and timeout without weakening named expectations.
